hypothesis: A low-turnover, per-asset 180-day trend sign held for 28 days across five major USD-M perpetuals retains positive net expectancy after fees and funding when position weights are set from ex-ante 60-day volatility.
independence_from_alpha006: Alpha 006 ranked assets against each other every week. Alpha 008 makes an absolute sign decision independently for every asset once per month and sizes by prior volatility; no cross-sectional rank is used.

research_basis.title: Time series momentum
research_basis.adaptation_note: The paper studies diversified futures rather than crypto; transfer to five crypto perpetuals is an unproven hypothesis, not borrowed evidence.

data_status: Static five-asset Binance history is project-seen and survivor-biased; development can reject the candidate but cannot produce final OOS approval.

rules.decision_time: first 4h candle at 00:00 UTC on calendar day 1
rules.signal: long when completed daily close / close 180 days ago - 1 > 0; short when < 0
rules.realized_volatility: 60 completed daily log returns annualized by sqrt(365)

costs.funding: Freqtrade historical funding included and reported separately

prohibited: opening the locked timerange before the development gate passes
changing 180-day signal, 60-day volatility, 28-day hold, stop, cap, rebalance date, or asset list after seeing development
dropping the losing direction or assets after seeing results
using leverage to force the monthly target
claiming final OOS from this survivor-biased universe
